in_marathi.name: Ronavraaj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Dance
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ronavraaj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ronavraaj is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It is the name of the King of Dance in Hindu mythology, who is believed to entertain the gods with his divine dance.
